trail_n.en: This is where the trail ends.

trail_a.en: Then this is where ours begins.

lake_n.es: Las piedras no nos dejan pasar. Hay que rodear el lago.
lake_n.en: The rocks won't let us through. We have to go around the lake.

glint_n.es: ¡Antu, mira! Allá arriba, en la montaña… algo brilla.
glint_n.en: Antu, look! Up there on the mountain… something is shining.

glint_a.es: No, Nai. Está muy alto y ya va a oscurecer.
glint_a.en: No, Nai. It's too high, and it's getting dark.

glint_n2.es: Vinimos a encontrarnos, ¿no? Confía en mí. Solo una vez.
glint_n2.en: We came here to find ourselves, right? Trust me. Just this once.

duel_n.es: Antu… arriba, en el árbol. No apartes la mirada.
duel_n.en: Antu… up in the tree. Don't look away.

chase_a.es: Está bajando del árbol… nos sigue.
chase_a.en: It's climbing down… it's following us.

pack_n.es: Hay más… no los mires a los ojos. Sigue caminando.
pack_n.en: There are more… don't look them in the eye. Keep walking.

exit_a.es: Nos dejaron ir. Creo que por fin nos encontramos.
exit_a.en: They let us go. I think we finally found ourselves.
